# Law Offices of Jason Berke PC

> Queens, New York civil litigation practice focusing on title disputes, partition actions, and landlord–tenant disputes (residential and commercial). The firm also assists clients with wills, New York health care proxies, and powers of attorney.

- Preferred name: Law Offices of Jason Berke PC
- Attorney: Jason Berke, Esq.
- Address: 125-10 Queens Blvd, Suite 222, Kew Gardens, NY 11415
- Phone: (718) 793-2488 Ext. 104
- Email: jasonrossberke@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.queenseviction.com/

Information on these pages is for general informational purposes only and is not legal advice. Viewing the site does not create an attorney–client relationship.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.queenseviction.com/): Firm overview and consultation request
- [Practice Areas](https://www.queenseviction.com/practice-areas.html): List of litigation and document-preparation services

- [Contact](https://www.queenseviction.com/contact.html): Consultation form, office address, and map

## Practice pages

- [Queens eviction lawyer](https://www.queenseviction.com/queens-eviction-lawyer.html): Residential and commercial eviction cases in New York, including holdover and nonpayment proceedings
- [Queens landlord-tenant attorney](https://www.queenseviction.com/queens-landlord-tenant-attorney.html): Lease disputes and litigation for landlords and tenants in Queens
- [Holdover proceedings](https://www.queenseviction.com/holdover-proceedings.html): Lease expiration or termination cases and possession disputes
- [Queens holdover proceeding lawyer](https://www.queenseviction.com/queens-holdover-proceeding-lawyer.html): Holdover proceedings in Queens
- [Nonpayment proceedings](https://www.queenseviction.com/nonpayment-proceedings.html): Rent arrears cases, demands, and defenses
- [Queens nonpayment proceeding lawyer](https://www.queenseviction.com/queens-nonpayment-proceeding-lawyer.html): Nonpayment proceedings in Queens
- [Residential evictions](https://www.queenseviction.com/residential-evictions.html): Residential holdover and nonpayment cases
- [Commercial evictions](https://www.queenseviction.com/commercial-evictions.html): Commercial lease defaults and possession disputes
- [Queens commercial eviction lawyer](https://www.queenseviction.com/queens-commercial-eviction-lawyer.html): Commercial evictions in Queens
- [Yellowstone injunctions](https://www.queenseviction.com/yellowstone-injunctions.html): Preserving commercial lease rights while curing alleged defaults
- [Title disputes](https://www.queenseviction.com/title-disputes.html): Quiet title, deed challenges, and ownership claims
- [Partition cases](https://www.queenseviction.com/partition-cases.html): Co-owner and heir disputes, court-supervised sale or division
- [Real estate contract disputes](https://www.queenseviction.com/real-estate-contract-disputes.html): Purchase-contract defaults, specific performance, and damages
- [Landlord-tenant disputes](https://www.queenseviction.com/landlord-tenant.html): Residential and commercial lease disputes and summary proceedings
- [Wills, health care proxies, and powers of attorney](https://www.queenseviction.com/wills-health-care-proxy-power-of-attorney.html): Preparing and reviewing last wills and testaments, New York health care proxies, and powers of attorney

## Case notes

- [Notable Decisions](https://www.queenseviction.com/notable-decisions.html): Index of case notes on public court opinions and decisions in matters where Jason Berke was counsel
- [Deen v Holder (Sup Ct, Queens County 2021)](https://www.queenseviction.com/deen-v-holder.html): Case note on Index No. 701105/2020, an October 21, 2021 inquest before Justice Timothy J. Dufficy awarding $700,000 for assault and emotional distress and $100,000 for loss of consortium ($800,000 before interest), with interest from November 17, 2013; judgment entered November 29, 2021; the certified transcript lists Jason R. Berke as plaintiffs’ counsel
- [Ajie Chen v Deliso (App Div, 2d Dept 2019)](https://www.queenseviction.com/ajie-chen-v-deliso.html): Case note on 2019 NY Slip Op 01054 [169 AD3d 761], dismissal of intentional and negligent infliction of emotional distress claims; the opinion lists Jason Berke of counsel for the appellant
- [Gardner v Lefkowitz (S.D.N.Y. 2019)](https://www.queenseviction.com/gardner-v-lefkowitz.html): Case note on No. 1:05-cv-05193 (DAB) (JCF), January 23, 2019 order vacating an October 2005 default judgment of $180,493.82 in light of a Second Circuit remand; a later stipulation dismissed the action with prejudice and stated that the claims were settled for $25,400; the Southern District notice of electronic filing lists Jason Ross Berke among counsel of record who received the order
- [Courchevel 1850 LLC v Stern (E.D.N.Y. 2018)](https://www.queenseviction.com/courchevel-1850-llc-v-stern.html): Case note on No. 17-CV-1794 (NGG) (JO), dismissal without prejudice of a foreclosure complaint for failure to plead RPAPL 1304 notice after the borrower moved; the public docket lists Jason R. Berke of Berke & Berke for defendant Isaac Stern
- [1211 Gilbert Ave. Holdings LLC v Berri (Sup Ct, Bronx County 2025)](https://www.queenseviction.com/1211-gilbert-ave-holdings-v-berri.html): Case note on 2025 NY Slip Op 50142(U), a time-of-the-essence closing, dismissal of specific performance and contract-damages claims, retention of a $35,000 deposit, and cancellation of a notice of pendency; the firm was counsel for the defendant (seller)
- [Lee v Chin (App Div, 1st Dept 2026)](https://www.queenseviction.com/lee-v-chin.html): Case note on 2026 NY Slip Op 01851, lease riders, a merger clause, and dismissed fraud and declaratory claims; the firm was counsel for the appellant
